title: Mother Beats Her Daughter Then Thinks She Can Get Away With It
description:
On February 12th, 2024. Police responded to a call regarding a woman who had been beating her child at home. When officers talked to the mother she tried putting the blame on her daughter & said she was an "actress" and also said her daughter had been the one abusing her. Officers then conducted an interview on the kids and found out that the mom was the aggressor and she was the one that had been beating her daughter, her other daughter was also a witness to the events that took place.
